description: Inspect table schemas, physical units and original scientific provenance within a canvas_id returned by a producing POWER tool. Tokens are process-local capabilities; only the supplied canvas is inspected.

canvas_id.description: Canvas token returned by a producing POWER tool

table.description: One table name from a producing response; omit to inspect this canvas

name: nasa_power_dataframe_describe

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_limit`: Complete table provenance exceeds the structured or rendered response budget. `canvas_unavailable`: Analytical workspace is disabled or native support is unavailable. `canvas_not_found`: Token is absent, expired or belongs to another tenant. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: Another operation occupies this canvas. `missing_table`: The named table is absent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

tables.description: Only tables within the supplied canvas

items.description: One staged table and its source provenance
One native column with its scientific interpretation

expiresAt.description: Current table expiry when independently tracked

envelope.description: Complete scientific envelope excluding observation rows

title: Describe staged POWER tables
